summary: Complete human finding review, versioned claim drafts, evidence export and manual follow-up before server rollout.
acceptance: Explicit append-only confirm/dismiss/accept decisions with reason/actor/time tied to immutable run/finding; current membership and optimistic review version enforced without invalidating analysis inputs.
One stable claim per operation/invoice document, initialized from one explicitly confirmed finding, reused across reanalyses without automatic amount aggregation or duplicate claims.

Correction claim amount/provider/currency/evidence resolved by server from eligible confirmed positive service/price finding; clarification leaves requested amount null; no arithmetic/tax or uncertain claim money invented.
Editable persisted draft revisions and explicit reviewed rebind to new run preserve originals, exported revisions and audit; changed inputs/decisions block emission until reviewed.
Authorized versioned TXT and JSON evidence exports with exact sources/checksums/provenance, no secrets/public object URLs/storage paths; export/copy does not mark sent.
Manual sent/reply/resolution and next follow-up date with internal overdue signal, strict date/state validation and immutable history; no automatic SMTP, external ERP or accounting writes.
Concise compact accessible UI, original/decision/claim history, stable dialogs and recoverable conflicts, no viewer mutation/export business writes.
Meaningful real HTTP tests, independent architecture/domain/UX/QA/browser review, full quality gate and guide/status updates before verified.
semanticRouting: Phase4 adds financial review and claim domain behavior, current authorized tenant writes/exports, schema/contracts/API, draft and tracking audit, and new UX. Product/domain and architecture/design decisions precede dependent implementation. Financial rules/parser/jobs are preserved; server rollout remains phase5.

excludedRoles.reason: No external connector, SMTP transport, ERP, queue or import adapter changes; downloads are a first-party authorized API response.
No parser, model, OCR or extraction changes; claims use immutable existing analysis evidence and deterministic reviewable templates.

limitations: Server deployment, TLS, production secrets, backups/restoration and deployed real-auth E2E remain phase5.
MVP claim identity is operation/invoice document with one selected finding; additional structured charge aggregation requires persistent charge identity and explicit future scope.
independenceRationale: Human financial decisions, claim amount integrity, protected commercial evidence export and cross-tenant access require independent architecture/security/data and product/domain/UX/QA acceptance.
